ns2:course.label: Electronic Matls & Proc, I
ns2:course.description: (MATSE 360) Introduces senior engineers and new graduate students to the materials science, engineering, and processing of semiconductors. The structure and chemistry of semiconductors are related to the electronic and optical properties. Includes: how semiconductors are produced and how to control processing to achieve desired materials properties; how to design and produce novel materials to obtain superior performance from electronic devices Prerequisite: PHYS 214; MATH 385 or consent of instructor; MSE 304 or PHYS 460 or equivalent.
